findings.title: Authentication enforcement is not visible on the protected route
findings.rule: Access must establish an authenticated actor before reading owner-scoped data.
findings.evidence: The route declaration lacks explicit auth middleware, and the controller directly dereferences $request->user()->id. No bootstrap or middleware configuration is supplied.
findings.confidence: High for the source omission, limited for deployed behavior
findings.attack_path_preconditions: An unauthenticated caller reaches GET /api/users if no global middleware protects it and the action is successfully invoked.
findings.impact: Guest handling may fail rather than return a controlled 401. Cross-owner data exposure is not established by this source; owner filtering is present.
findings.exploit_status: UNVERIFIED: no executable target or complete middleware stack
findings.repair: In the real app, verify global/route authentication enforcement; use the existing guard consistently and resolve a typed request. Add the appropriate auth middleware only if coverage is missing.
findings.validation: On an isolated executable app, assert guest 401, valid actor own records only, other-owner exclusion, invalid/expired credentials denied and controlled behavior when identity is absent.

observations.text: Query derives owner_id from request identity rather than a client-supplied owner id; this is positive source evidence of object scoping, not proof of runtime authorization.

Model extends Eloquent Model, with no visible Authenticatable contract, token support or sensitive-field serialization rules. Its intended role as authenticatable principal is unverified; do not call this an exploit.
Laravel uses wildcard version and no composer.lock is supplied. Resolved versions and current advisory exposure cannot be established; no vulnerable package claim is made.
Only a duplicate-phone precondition test exists; it supplies no authentication or ownership validation.

intended_actions: Use the current PHP/Laravel stack; obtain the actual authentication routes, guards/middleware, controllers/services, principal model, session/token settings, lockfile and existing auth tests for the next bounded audit phase.

Trace registration, login, logout, password/OTP reset, verification, token/session issuance, expiry and revocation only when their source is supplied; inspect enumeration, throttling, CSRF/cookie settings, tenant/role isolation and secret handling where relevant.
Validate AUTH-01 and the owner boundary using focused negative tests on an explicitly permitted isolated target with synthetic actors; no runtime target is currently available.

Report severity, preconditions, evidence and minimal remediation for supported findings. Any later authorized fixes should preserve public contracts and update only affected docs under spec/api; no changes are made in this audit.

concise_persian_response: ممیزی احراز هویت را با security-assurance در حالت FULL_AUDIT بررسی کردم؛ نتیجهٔ فعلی فقط بر کد موجود تکیه دارد. در routes/api.php:3 میان‌افزار احراز هویت دیده نمی‌شود و UserController.php:4 بدون کنترل هویت به شناسهٔ کاربر دسترسی دارد. این یک ریسک مشروط با شدت متوسط است؛ تنظیمات سراسری در دسترس نیست و دورزدن احراز هویت یا نشت داده اثبات نشده است. محدودکردن پرس‌وجو با owner_id در کد وجود دارد. پیاده‌سازی ورود، خروج، بازیابی رمز، توکن و نشست، فایل قفل وابستگی‌ها و محیط اجرایی موجود نیست؛ بنابراین ممیزی کامل Subsystem هنوز قابل تأیید نیست. گام بعدی، بررسی همین اجزا و آزمون مهمان، اعتبارنامهٔ نامعتبر و جداسازی دادهٔ دو کاربر در محیط ایزوله است. هیچ کد یا وضعیت بیرونی تغییر نکرده است.
